result.detail: Neither tool run satisfies the evidence requirement 'Merged coverage with reviewed exclusions'. run-0001 (coverage.read) failed because the sources and top parameters were missing. run-0002 (veritriage.investigate) failed because no artifact paths were given. A rerun should use sources=[lifo4_fcov.sv plus the lifo4 RTL] and top=lifo4_fcov or the testbench top. Even then, coverage.read measures line and toggle coverage on design files only, so functional closure rests on the testbench reading the planned and holes ports. Reset is synchronous and active low. A reset bin is hit when rst_n is low at an edge and count is not 0. Hit bits are never cleared, including by reset. The model treats 'empty' as count==0 and 'full' as count==4, following the matrix; the empty and full ports are not used to select bins. din, dout and err are unused and are marked lint_off. The CDC assumption does not affect this task.
